paragraphs: Rav Chanan and Rav Anan saw a man sowing seeds together. He said to him, “Let the Master come and place him under a ban.” He replied, “You are not clear”—the laws of mixed species are not clear to you. Again they saw him sowing wheat and barley among vines. He said, “Let the Master place him under a ban.” He replied, “You are not illuminated”—the laws of mixed species do not shine clearly for you, since we hold like R. Yoshiyah: Kiddushin 39a. “R. Avin said: R. Chanan said: Rav said.”
